header_sentences: See Animal Kingdom, Celestial Kingdom, Natural Kingdom, and Spiritual Kingdom; and also see King.

contexts.text: He was now in another kingdom...
In so large a kingdom...
Kingdoms, in the Word, = truths, and the things which are of Truths.
Kingdom against kingdom () = falsities against falsities. AC 2120:end. AC 2547:3. AC 3353:end.
Of no use in (that) kingdom... The things in the kingdom of the world had been left behind.
Thou hast brought upon... my kingdom a great sin () = that all doctrinal things were in danger... Kingdom = the truth of doctrine, or what is doctrinal.
That kingdom = the truths of doctrine; and, in the opposite sense, falsities of doctrine. Illustrated.

By kingdoms (in Daniel) are meant the states of the Church as to truths and falsities... The states of... the kingdoms of the earth in the sense of the letter are states of the Church and of the Lord's Kingdom in the internal sense. AE 412:31.
Kingdoms () = doctrinals of falsity. AC 2832:14.
Kingdoms = the truths which are of the Church.
Therefore, the truths themselves which are from the Lord are called the sons of the kingdom ().
The kingdoms of the nations () = falsities from evils.
The kingdom of the Messiah. Described.
Kingdom = truth. AC 5313:2.

These two Kingdoms are presented in man by the two kingdoms in him, which are the kingdom of the will and the kingdom of the understanding... Hence, too, it is that in man's body there are also two kingdoms, namely, of the heart and of the lungs.
The sons of the kingdom () = those who are in the vastated Church. ( = those who are of the Church. AC 7688.)
Kingdom is predicated of truth; and dominion, of good. Illustrated. AC 4973:6. AE 331:9.
Saul's rending the skirt of Samuel's coat () represented... that the kingdom should be cut off from him... for, in the internal sense, a kingdom = Divine truth. References.
Under Heart, see this reference. HH 95.
If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand ()... By a kingdom is signified truth.
The kingdom () = the truths of doctrine therein.
A kingdom of uses.
(The loves of self and of the world the origin of empires and kingdoms.) AC 8118.
Empires and kingdoms are represented in Heaven as a man...
Nations = evils; and kingdoms, falsities.
Ye shall be to Me a kingdom of priests () = the good of truth then... A kingdom of priests = spiritual good, which is the good of truth... A kingdom = truth.

There was first a kingdom of judges, afterwards a kingdom of priests, and finally a kingdom of kings; and by the kingdom of judges was represented Divine truth from Divine good; by the kingdom of priests, who were also judges, was represented Divine good from which is Divine truth; and by the kingdom of kings, Divine truth without Divine good... (Continued. See Celestial Kingdom.)
(In Saturn) there are no cities, nor kingdoms...
The kingdom of Belshazzar divided = the dissipation of good and truth.
The sons of the kingdom, who are the seed () = the truths of faith of the Church. The sons of the evil kingdom, who are the tares () = the falsities of faith of the Church.
Therefore they were divided into two kingdoms.
The sons of the kingdom () = Divine truths in Heaven and the Church... The kingdom = Heaven, and also the Church.
The Word of the kingdom () = the truth of Heaven and the Church; for the kingdom = Heaven and the Church.
Each Kingdom is tripartite...
Inauguration to represent the Lord in both Kingdoms. Signified.
To commit whoredom with all the kingdoms of the earth () = to do so with all the truths of the Church. AE 141:13.
That Heaven is distinguished into two Kingdoms. General article.
They are called Kingdoms, because Heaven is called the Kingdom of God.
Who is the Lord of that kingdom...
The laws of that kingdom are eternal Truths...
The two kingdoms of Hell. (See Celestial Kingdom.)
(The representation of the kingdoms of the Christian world.)
The kingdom () = the Church.
The Hells are also distinguished into two kingdoms... the Diabolic Kingdom and the Satanic Kingdom. Explained. AE 655:2. AE 740:3. AE 1043:2.
The kingdoms of the world are become of our Lord and His Christ () = that Heaven and the Church have become the Lord's, as they had been from the beginning, and now also of His Divine Human. AE 683.
Thou hast entered into the kingdom () = that Heaven and the Church are now His, as before. By His Kingdom is here meant the New Heaven and the New Church. AE 691.
To give their kingdom unto the beast () = to acknowledge the Word, and found the Church upon it. Explained. AE 1086.
That kingdom = the Church. Illustrated.
The reason kingdom = the Church, is that the Lord's Kingdom is in Heaven and on earth, and His Kingdom on earth is the Church. Hence the Lord is called the King of kings.

Thy kingdom come... The Father's kingdom comes when the Lord is immediately approached... Therefore the Lord said to His disciples that they should preach the Kingdom of God, and this is the Kingdom of God.
Thy kingdom come = that the Lord shall reign. Illustrated.

In the kingdom () = in the Church where truths are. (For) a kingdom, in the Word, = Heaven and the Church. The reason it = the Church as to truth, or where truths are, is that by the Lord's royalty is signified the Divine truth which proceeds from Him...
That kingdom, in the Word, = Heaven and the Church as to truths. Illustrated.
To hear the Word of the Kingdom = to hear the truths of the Church.
Kingdom against kingdom = falsity against truth.
Thy kingdom come = that truth may be received.
Thine is the kingdom, the power, and the glory = that Divine truth is from God alone.
The reason Heaven is signified by kingdom, is that Heaven with the Angels is from no other source than the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord's Divine Human.
These two kingdoms of the mind correspond to the two kingdoms of the body...
Kingdom against kingdom = Church against Church.
Kingdoms = the truths which make the Church.
By kingdoms, in like manner as by peoples, are signified falsities.
The reason kingdom = the Church, is that the Lord's Kingdom is where the Church is; and therefore those who are of the Church are called the sons of the kingdom.
Kingdom against kingdom = that falsity will fight with falsity.
For kingdom = the truth of the Church; and, in the opposite sense, its falsity.
Kingdom = the Church and Heaven. AE 455:4.
Kingdoms are predicated of truths; and, in the opposite sense, of falsities.
Kingdoms = Churches, as to truths, and as to falsities.
For in the southern part (of Heaven) the Divine itself which proceeds is such, which is meant by the kingdom prepared from the foundation of the world.
Therefore, those who receive the Divine truth are called by the Lord the sons of the Kingdom.
Kingdom = Heaven and the Church as to the truth of doctrine.
The kingdoms which he has made to tremble () = the Churches into which the general Church is distinguished.
Kingdoms = the truths of the Church.
That there will be contentions of Churches together, is signified by... kingdom against kingdom (). City = doctrine, and kingdom = the Church thence.
Kingdom against kingdom () = that falsity will fight with falsity... Kingdom = those who are in falsities, of whom is the Church.
Kingdoms () = Churches distinguished according to truths.
His kingdom was made darkness () = the Church in mere and dense falsities. Kingdom = the Church as to truths.
To have a kingdom () = domination; and it is said of truths or of falsities. Kingdom = the Church as to truths or falsities.
The two Kingdoms conjoined into one... Signified.
One kingdom of nature has been created for another, the mineral kingdom for the vegetable kingdom, and this for the animal kingdom, and all for the human race...

All of one kingdom appear before the Lord as one man according to the love of uses... Those in the kingdoms who love the uses of their offices because they are uses appear together as a man Angel; and those who love the uses of their offices for the sake of pleasures alone separate from the uses appear together as a man devil...
The Divine love there... is distinguished into two kingdoms... The Divine love... is further distinguished into lesser kingdoms, which may be called provinces, and these again into Societies...
So diabolical love... is there distinguished into two kingdoms...

When it pleases the Lord, each kingdom is presented before the Angels in Heaven as one man... When anyone sees a kingdom as one man, he can see the quality of it; and according thereto it is the neighbour.
That ... each empire, kingdom, and republic is the neighbour according to its good of religion and of morals...
Holy Spirit. 5. 5. This Church is the kingdom of saints... in Daniel.
